description: Wire the global-dedup upload flow into BOTH upload paths using the FEAT-001 storage + store APIs. Every upload is staged (hashed once) BEFORE placement, the hash is looked up globally, and the file is finalized into photos/ (original) or recyclebin/ (duplicate, is_trash=true, dup_of=original.ID). Both paths always return HTTP 201 + an ETag derived from the stored hash so the iPhone marks the item backed up and never retries. Depends on FEAT-001 (StageTemp/FinalizeStaged/RemoveStaged, GetBySHA256, indexable is_trash/dup_of).
steps: internal/webdav/dav.go: extend indexPhoto to carry trash metadata — e.g. change signature to indexPhoto(ctx, res *storage.Result, mtime time.Time, isTrash bool, dupOf *int64) and set store.Photo.IsTrash/DupOf accordingly; update its single existing caller semantics (now via the helper below). OriginalName should remain path.Base(res.RelPath).

internal/webdav/dav.go: add `storeWithDedup(ctx context.Context, staged *storage.StageResult, baseName string, mtime time.Time) (*storage.Result, bool, error)`: call h.pg.GetBySHA256(ctx, staged.SHA256). If a row is found -> finalize via h.store.FinalizeStaged(staged.TempRel, "recyclebin", baseName, staged.SHA256, mtime), indexPhoto(..., isTrash=true, dupOf=&existing.ID), and h.logger.Warn("phát hiện trùng → đưa vào thùng rác", "hash", staged.SHA256[:12], "rel", res.RelPath, "gốc", existing.RelPath), return res,true,nil. Else finalize into "photos", indexPhoto(..., isTrash=false, dupOf=nil), return res,false,nil. If GetBySHA256 errors, treat as non-dup (log Warn) so a DB hiccup never blocks a backup — still finalize into photos. On FinalizeStaged error, h.store.RemoveStaged(staged.TempRel) and return the error.

internal/webdav/dav.go put(): replace the WriteAtomic(rel, r.Body, expected, mtime) call with staged, err := h.store.StageTemp(r.Body, expected); on err log + 500. Then res, _, err := h.storeWithDedup(r.Context(), staged, path.Base(rel), mtime); on err RemoveStaged already done in helper, log + 500. Set w.Header OC-ETag and ETag to fmt.Sprintf("%q", res.SHA256[:16]); WriteHeader(201). Keep the existing INFO "đã lưu ảnh" log reporting res.RelPath/res.Size/res.SHA256[:12]. NEVER return an error status for a duplicate.

internal/webdav/chunk.go uploadAssemble(): after assembling the io.MultiReader of chunk files, call staged, err := h.store.StageTemp(multi, expected) instead of WriteAtomic(dest, ...). closeAll(files) as today. Still h.store.Remove(chunkDirRel(uuidRel)) to drop temp chunks. On StageTemp err: log + 500 (and RemoveStaged if a temp was created). Then res, _, err := h.storeWithDedup(r.Context(), staged, path.Base(dest), mtime); set OC-ETag from res.SHA256[:16]; WriteHeader(201); keep the INFO "đã ghép & lưu video/ảnh lớn" log but report res.RelPath (the finalized path, which may be under recyclebin).
internal/webdav/dav.go: verify the `time` and `path` imports are still used; remove WriteAtomic usage only where replaced (MOVE handler still uses WriteAtomic and must keep working).
acceptance_criteria: go build ./... and go vet ./... both pass.
Both put() (small PUT) and uploadAssemble() (chunked MOVE .file) route through StageTemp -> GetBySHA256 -> FinalizeStaged and call indexPhoto with the correct is_trash/dup_of.

A first upload of given bytes is finalized under photos/<yyyymm>/ with is_trash=false; a second upload of the SAME bytes (any name) is finalized under recyclebin/<yyyymm>/ with is_trash=true and dup_of set to the original row id; BOTH responses are HTTP 201 with an OC-ETag/ETag of res.SHA256[:16].
The duplicate path emits a Vietnamese WARN log and NEVER returns an HTTP error.
verification: Runtime (best-effort, needs throwaway Postgres + Redis app-password): start ./cmd/server with a temp .env (APP_DATA_DIR=mktemp -d, APP_PG_DSN to throwaway PG, empty TLS), PUT the same small JPEG twice via curl with Basic auth; confirm first file under photos/<yyyymm>/, second under recyclebin/<yyyymm>/, both 201. If Redis is unavailable, instead add/adjust a Go test driving storeWithDedup against a real/throwaway Postgres (skip with t.Skip when APP_PG_DSN is unset) and note it in findings.
findings:
WIRED the stage->global-dedup->finalize flow into BOTH upload paths via a shared helper.

internal/webdav/dav.go:
- indexPhoto signature extended to indexPhoto(ctx, res *storage.Result, mtime time.Time, isTrash bool, dupOf *int64); sets store.Photo.IsTrash/DupOf. OriginalName stays path.Base(res.RelPath). All callers updated (put via helper, MOVE passes false,nil).
- Added storeWithDedup(ctx, staged *storage.StageResult, baseName string, mtime time.Time) (*storage.Result, bool, error): calls h.pg.GetBySHA256(staged.SHA256). If a row is found -> FinalizeStaged into "recyclebin", indexPhoto(isTrash=true, dupOf=&existing.ID), Vietnamese WARN "phát hiện trùng → đưa vào thùng rác" (hash/rel/gốc), returns res,true,nil. Else -> FinalizeStaged into "photos", indexPhoto(false,nil), returns res,false,nil. GetBySHA256 error is logged as WARN and treated as NON-dup (DB hiccup never blocks a backup -> still finalized into photos). On FinalizeStaged error: RemoveStaged(staged.TempRel) then return err.
- put() now: StageTemp(r.Body, expected) (on err 500) -> storeWithDedup(path.Base(rel)) (on err 500; RemoveStaged already done in helper) -> set OC-ETag AND ETag to %q of res.SHA256[:16]; WriteHeader(201); keep INFO "đã lưu ảnh" (rel/size/sha256[:12]). Never returns an error for a duplicate.
- MOVE handler still uses store.WriteAtomic (unchanged, working); updated only its indexPhoto call to the new signature.

internal/webdav/chunk.go uploadAssemble(): after building the io.MultiReader, calls StageTemp(multi, expected) (replacing WriteAtomic), closeAll(files) as before, h.store.Remove(chunkDirRel(uuidRel)) to drop temp chunks, then storeWithDedup(filepath.Base(dest)) -> OC-ETag from res.SHA256[:16], WriteHeader(201), keeps INFO "đã ghép & lưu video/ảnh lớn" now reporting the finalized res.RelPath (may be under recyclebin/). Used filepath.Base (not path.Base) because chunk.go already imports path/filepath and NOT path; equivalent for slash paths on Linux, avoids adding an import.

VERIFICATION: go build ./... + go vet ./... pass from the worktree. Added internal/webdav/dedup_test.go (package webdav, stdlib testing) driving storeWithDedup twice with identical bytes: asserts first -> photos/202303/ (dup=false), second (different name) -> recyclebin/202303/ (dup=true), both same SHA256, dup row has is_trash=true and dup_of=original.ID, both via HTTP-equivalent Result. The test t.Skip's when APP_PG_DSN is unset (Redis/Postgres unavailable in sandbox) and cleans up its throwaway rows; it SKIPPED here (no APP_PG_DSN). go test ./internal/webdav/... ./internal/storage/... passes.
